card.title: HENDERSON FIELD
card.text: Henderson Field is the air base the US is constructing on Guadalcanal.

Text.SourceString: Henderson Field is the air base the US is constructing on Guadalcanal.
Text.LocalizedString: Henderson Field is the air base the US is constructing on Guadalcanal.

value.value: The Matanikau Valley sits between us and the Matanikau River. It is full of hidden Japanese units, so advance with caution.

SourceString.value: The Matanikau Valley sits between us and the Matanikau River. It is full of hidden Japanese units, so advance with caution.

value.value: Henderson Field is nearing being fully operational, we are making good use of it now.

SourceString.value: Henderson Field is nearing being fully operational, we are making good use of it now.

value.value: The Marines are experts in infiltrating enemy lines and hunting down enemy units.

SourceString.value: The Marines are experts in infiltrating enemy lines and hunting down enemy units.

value.value: Our enemy has not dared contest the waters around Guadalcanal, so no nasty surprises from them.

SourceString.value: Our enemy has not dared contest the waters around Guadalcanal, so no nasty surprises from them.

value.value: We are in the home stretch now. The enemy has amassed defenses across the Matanikau River, so some caution is advised.

value.value: Advancing further in has exposed more enemy units!
